scope: Operator execution policies only; native hardware provenance remains in parameter_source_audit.json.
hash_convention: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)

vector_serial_policy_v1.title: 独立 Vector 串行执行与 UB 服务假设
vector_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit analytical policy; no published or measured UB bandwidth claim

normalization_serial_policy_v1.title: RMSNorm/Softmax 分行分阶段执行与归约依赖假设
normalization_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit coarse work and storage policy; no silicon calibration claim

materialized_block_policy_v1.title: Materialized Decode block schedule and storage-boundary work proxies
materialized_block_policy_v1.verification: Explicit symbolic storage and uncalibrated compute assumptions; no numerical or physical-layout validation claim

decode_attention_policy_v1.title: Single-token Decode with shared KV backing and serial query heads
decode_attention_policy_v1.verification: Native GEMM/Softmax reuse, independent workload/cache checks; symbolic layout and uncalibrated memory-service policies

fixed_routing_moe_policy_v1.title: Fixed-routing serial MoE experts with resident weights and FP32 outputs
fixed_routing_moe_policy_v1.verification: Analytical payload/work/liveness tests; no numerical inference, physical index ISA or hardware calibration claim

ascend_ub_read_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

ascend_ub_write_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

configs/execution/vector.json.conditions: Separate execution profile; TSP/CIM share one policy. tile_elements=1024 is an overridable software default, not a hardware limit or a verified optimum. Tiling search belongs to Issue #4; this clarification changes no execution parameter values.

fp32_sub_cost.decision: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.decision: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.decision: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.decision: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.

to_fp32_cost.decision: Coarse storage-boundary conversion work; no standalone instruction model.

to_int8_cost.decision: Coarse scale/round/clamp work proxy; no numerical quantization or standalone instruction model.

fp32_rcp_cost.decision: Reciprocal work proxy on the shared Vector/VXM budget.

configs/execution/attention.json.conditions: Single-token Decode with uniform cache lengths. INT8 what-if storage, FP32 scale/Softmax. Preallocated per-KV-head backing is shared; each query head rereads K/V using native GEMM, with no physical repeat or transpose instruction. Q/K/V projection, position processing, output projection, cache eviction and chip execution are outside this block.

decode_projection_blocks.conditions: Single-token bias-free GQA projections. INT8 activation/matrix weights and outputs; RMSNorm scale weight and internal normalization FP32. Existing to_fp32/to_int8 proxies, no new measured hardware rate. Serial materialized nodes; head/matrix views share storage symbolically and require physical layout validation. No RoPE, numeric quantization, MLA composition or chip execution.

decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.conditions: Single-token full-head adjacent-channel RoPE with one uniform batch position and supplied FP32 cos/sin tables. No table generation; tables reread per head. INT8 Q/K and embedding/output activations; vocabulary logits FP32. Embedding assumes symbolic valid INT32 indices, complete INT8 table residency and no duplicate-row cache. Native matrix and existing conversion/SUB costs reused; no new hardware rates, address-generation or gather/transpose instructions, numeric accuracy, MLA composition or chip execution.
decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.rope_workspace: One pair uses 8 B converted input plus four 4 B products; converted-input slots become rotation results only after all four products. Local stored input/table/output slots add 12 B per pair.
decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.embedding_workspace: Local DMA path retains a 4 B index and one reusable row tile. Resident MEM copies have no second full table/output copy; transient address registers are not modeled.

mla_preprocessing_and_cache.conditions: Single-token low-rank Q and KV preprocessing, supplied cos/sin tables and uniform batch position. Three native INT8 GEMMs, two FP32 normalizations, materialized channel selections with cast/read/write work, and two positional rotations. Shared INT8 latent/position cache appends once per batch and streams each filled component once. These INT8 and serial materialization policies are project assumptions, distinct from official FP8/BF16 inference. No measured rates added.
mla_preprocessing_and_cache.cache_profile_usage: Uses existing attention profile append-only capacity and symbolic-view layout. Query-head scheduling/reuse fields are inactive in standalone MLA cache; read_policy explicitly specifies one stream per batch/component.
mla_preprocessing_and_cache.cache_storage: Reserve one maximum-size native score/value backing per batch for latent KV, one score backing for positional K. Native padding and slice striping included; no query-head replication. Physical layout compatibility and address/transpose instructions remain outside scope.
mla_preprocessing_and_cache.excluded: Direct Q rank-zero path, absorbed attention core and its two Wkvb projection uses, output integration, MoE, chip partition, table generation/YaRN policy and full-model assembly.

mla_absorbed_attention.conditions: Serial single-token absorbed MLA on preprocessed queries. Five native INT8 GEMMs per query head, explicit conversions, FP32 score add/scale/Softmax and optional existing output projection. Shared cache appended once with no redundant standalone read; native reads repeat per head. Inputs, weights, cache and context persist; one head workspace reused, output temporaries allocate after all heads. No new measured rates or profile parameter changes.
mla_absorbed_attention.weight_views: One KV up weight [heads,nope_dim+v_dim,kv_rank], with disjoint native-padded K and V subranges per head. These weights are shared across batch items; transpose/packing is symbolic, with no numerical weight dequantization model.
mla_absorbed_attention.scale: base=1/sqrt(nope_dim+rope_dim). Workload scale_multiplier defaults to 1; a non-default multiplier needs nonempty scale_source. Caller may supply squared YaRN mscale explicitly; no inference from cache capacity or automatic context-extension policy. Scale is applied once after FP32 score addition.
mla_absorbed_attention.excluded: Numerical FP8/BF16 accuracy, physical repacking/transpose instructions, direct rank-zero Q preprocessing, prefill/masks/sliding-window/eviction/paging, chip execution, MoE and full-model assembly.

moe_fixed_routing_experts.reference_scope: Expert's three linear layers and SwiGLU; count per selected expert; shared widened MLP. Gate and weighted combine are explicitly excluded.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.precision: Project INT8 matrix/SwiGLU storage, INT32 matrix accumulation and FP32 expert outputs. Existing conversion proxies are explicit; no final per-expert INT8 conversion.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.routing: Caller-supplied distinct in-range expert IDs per token, uniform top_k. One INT32 indices payload read per slot; actual token counts and output slots retained.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.storage: All declared routed/shared weights resident with native padding, including inactive experts. Packed input and FFN intermediates reused per expert; routed destination overlaps temporary FP32 publish source. Shared output allocates in its final conversion.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.traffic: One INT8 input-row copy and one FP32 output-row copy per assignment; no deduplication, free dispatch, implicit physical transpose or index instruction assumption.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.timing: Serial active experts then shared FFN, existing native matrix/vector/memory services; no expert parallelism or overlap.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.profiles: Existing hardware, vector/blocks/attention profile values and hashes unchanged.
moe_fixed_routing_experts.excluded: Router GEMM/scoring/group/Top-K selection, route weights/normalization, weighted/shared summation, offloaded weights, inter-resource communication, full model and numerical accuracy.

moe_router_combine.reference_scope: Gate sigmoid/bias/group selection/original-score normalization/scaling, weighted experts and shared addition. Official BF16/FP8 precision is not reproduced.
moe_router_combine.selection: Repeated maximum without replacement; sum_j(N-j-1) comparisons, max(compute, ceil(log2(N-j))*reduction_round_cycles) per round. Group max or biased top2 sum. Symbolic masks, indices and addresses; explicit payload traffic, no detailed selection ISA.
moe_router_combine.precision: INT8 gate/experts, INT32 accumulation, FP32 sigmoid/weights/combine; optional final INT8 conversion. Existing conversion and reciprocal proxies.
moe_router_combine.storage: External weights/inputs persist; full score rows materialized. Post-router buffers release before experts, indices before combine; weights and FP32 expert outputs survive through combine. Global padding, stripe and scratch reservations verified.
moe_router_combine.routing_scenario: Whole MoE receives explicit assignments satisfying group/top-k constraints; router work is modeled but numeric expert selection is not computed or verified.
moe_router_combine.profiles: Existing hardware and vector/blocks/attention parameter values/hashes unchanged. No measured coefficients introduced.
